node.title: FLOOR CONJECTURE (ROWWISE-ENVELOPE): non-planted low-slack contributions obey the certified K_cell/q^sigma envelope at official rows
node.statement: FLOOR RE-POSE (2026-07-07, floor campaign): the consumers already weakened (2026-07-06): list_planted_arithmetic needs only 'row by row, a certified upper envelope for every non-extremal/non-planted contribution and explicit lower witnesses for unsafe rows' — NOT global two-class exhaustion. Exhaustion at official cells is PROVED (Lemma A: bg <= 1 = the official max-fill convention admits no third class). FLOOR: at every official row the non-planted low-slack contribution obeys the certified envelope consistent with the verified count law ~ K_cell/q^sigma. Pre-registered falsifier: an official-convention (bg <= 1) row family with challenger counts exceeding the envelope, sustained; open-window small-q counts do NOT refute (the sigma = 2 window closes by q = 97). Opening evidence: two censuses UNCLASSIFIED = 0 (77 + 219 cells); window law verified. | Price or exhaust the structured low-slack NON-planted challenger class (the E15 counterexample's family) so the revised worst_word_planted statement's sup-over-words claim is carried by planted + challenger classes jointly. For downstream list arithmetic, a weaker rowwise deliverable is also sufficient: a certified upper envelope for all non-planted low-slack contributions, together with explicit lower witnesses where the unsafe side is invoked. | RESOLVED STRUCTURE 2026-07-06 (goal: prove-or-falsify; see LEMMA_A_EXHAUSTION_PROOF.md): falsification attempts comprehensively FAILED (open-window sigma=2/q=17 cells, generic-background receivers, multiple q -- every non-planted list word touches >=2 petals under the official taxonomy). The EXHAUSTION half is now PROVED: Lemma A (one-paragraph, agreement-counting) shows bg<=1 max-fill cells admit NO third class at any sigma>=1, any q -- turning the censuses UNCLASSIFIED=0 into a theorem; hypothesis SHARP (bg=5/9 cells exhibit verified BG-ONLY and ONE-PETAL witnesses). The PRICING half has a verified law: challengers are codim-sigma coincidences, count ~ K_cell/q^sigma (1/q scaling measured; window transitions match u2c/dli). REMAINING KERNEL: the per-official-row certified envelope (count law at prize rows -- certification-shaped, the accepted crux-2 pattern) + the K_cell upper-bound lemma. | SURVIVAL +1 (2026-07-07, F7-A1 + A1b): the pre-registered E22 census COMPLETE — 135/135 cells (17 heavy cells finished sharded, 408 jobs), gate PASSED, ZERO unclassified hits anywhere; all 1,689 heavy-cell hits classify into the two challenger columns. | SURVIVAL +2 (2026-07-07, F7-A2): envelope stress across q — counts track K_cell/q^sigma (drift <= 1.5x over 12x in q), sigma=2 window-closure reproduced (identically zero, q >= 97), zero unclassified. | SURVIVAL +3 -> **HARDENED** (2026-07-07, F7-A3): adversarial layout-sup over 60 layouts bounded at <= 2.4x median, zero unclassified at 360 exact cells. Families: complete census / envelope q-stress / adversarial layout-sup. | Pro floor-window 7: no kill (audit-grade); proof lead banked: conditional row-envelope lemma (codimension-drop vs new-component dichotomy) + symbolic K_cell rank certificate as the theorem artifact. | CATCH #12 — COUNT-LAW BETA-NORMALIZATION (2026-07-07, correspondence beta-round, nodes/worst_word_challenger_pricing/notes/f7_beta_check.md, CENSUS-VERIFIED on Modal): at base-domain extension rows the worst word is base-valued and its challenger set over F_q EQUALS the base-row challenger set (interpolation through k base points forces base coefficients — proved + verified in 24/24 layouts at q = 17^2, 13^2: same K_cell, denominators p^sigma vs q^sigma, ratio exactly q/p). The count law must read ~ K_cell/|F_p(D, word)|^sigma (generated field). All banked evidence is prime-row (readings coincide) — untouched. Consumer rule: base-valued strata at non-generating rows are priced by the f1/ext descent at the base row; the envelope's residual claim covers the genuinely-F stratum. || SLACK-SCAN ADDENDUM (2026-07-09, floor_budget_slack_scan): NO FREE SLACK for the envelope without a conventions decision — QA.22 aggregate line at prize rows is 0.9 bits (conservative convention); the 27.0/60.6+ bit within-column staircase room requires re-attribution under the QA.22 conventions note (flagged, not spent). The rowwise envelope certification target stands as stated. | WP7 KERNEL-BASIS VERDICT (2026-07-10, notes/kernel_basis/WP7_WORSTWORD_VERDICT.md): Face-4 map ANALOGY-ONLY and mis-attributed (catch #27; retargeted to the XR gate). Actual kernel line: K2 via the SCK census door — certified per-row envelope = constant-exact SCK clause (ii) at the cell-conditional challenger fiber (pins P1/P2; M6-sibling at 0.9-bit slack); clause (i) PROVED locally (Lemma A); non-kernel items W1 (K_cell rank certificate), W2 (constructive lower witnesses), W3 (row-envelope dichotomy). || CONDITIONAL CLOSE — ROUTE OF RECORD (2026-07-10 amber audit, conditional-close rigor): IF ww_row_envelope_clause (W3, pins P1/P2) AND ww_kcell_upper_lemma (W1) AND ww_lower_witnesses (W2), THEN — composing with the PROVED links ww_lemma_a_exhaustion (clause (i)), the catch-#12 stratum join (base-valued stratum = the |B| = p instance of W3; f7_beta_check proved + 24/24), and the QA.22 budget fit (xr_target_budget_audit, 27/27 digest; dyadic_profile_evaluation replay PASS) — the floor holds at every official row, CELL-CONDITIONALLY on planted-sunflower receivers (receivers outside the family remain worst_word_planted's obligation — G3) at official crossing radii (G4), and the consumers' 2026-07-06 weakened needs are delivered verbatim. RE-SURGERY CRITERIA: (1) #493 ruling -> re-pin P2 only (no re-wiring); (2) any consumer sweep at sub-crossing radii -> re-audit Lemma A's c-slack hypothesis; (3) any official-convention unclassified hit -> revert to TARGET; (4) QA.22 conventions-note revision -> refresh allowance pins. EVIDENCE CITATION REPAIR (audit catch): the F7-A2 'drift <= 1.5x' claim is not reproducible under the natural metric — recomputed 1.75x/1.78x at (16,8,1) and 3.64x with a systematic rise at (16,4,1,linear) (small counts, Poisson-marginal); the A2 citation is restated with these figures; A1 claims fully reproduced (135/135 cells, 0 unclassified).
